title: HSK1 Gate 13 · Five Dynasties
explanationEn: Gate 13: Five Dynasties. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第13关：五代。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 很久以前，一本书要一个字一个字地写。写一本书要很多天。所以书很少，也很贵。后来，人们想到了一个好办法。
passageEn: Long ago, a book had to be written out one character at a time. Writing one book took many days. So books were few, and expensive. Later, people thought of a good way.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Long ago, a book had to be written out one character at a time.
comprehension.answer: 很久以前，一本书要一个字一个字地写。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: So books were few, and expensive.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 久 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“久”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 久 (jiǔ) means "long time" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “久”（jiǔ）的意思是“long time”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 以前 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“以前”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 以前 (yǐ qián) means "before" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “以前”（yǐ qián）的意思是“before”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 很久以前，一本书要一个字一个字地写。

options.text: Long ago, a book had to be written out one character at a time.
Long ago, great floods came to China.
The floods came, and many people had no home.

check.explanationEn: "很久以前，一本书要一个字一个字地写。" means "Long ago, a book had to be written out one character at a time.".
check.explanation: “很久以前，一本书要一个字一个字地写。”的意思是“Long ago, a book had to be written out one character at a time.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Five Dynasties in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说五代。
